subtasks.title: Implement shallow section replacement merge function
details: Implement a standalone `shallow_merge(global_dict: dict, local_dict: dict) -> dict` function in the config module.

For each key in `local_dict`: if the value is a dict (i.e. a TOML section), replace the entire corresponding key in `global_dict` wholesale; if the value is a scalar (top-level key), override the global scalar.
Keys present in `global_dict` but absent from `local_dict` are inherited unchanged.
Do NOT deep-merge nested keys — a section present in local replaces the entire global section.
Add unit tests for `shallow_merge` directly (in addition to end-to-end tests).

Include the `[spec_tool]` section in the template.
Ensure the template is valid TOML when comments are uncommented.

task_groups.title: Implement core load_config function with global+local loading, symlink rejection, and debug logging

subtasks.title: Implement HOME resolution, global config auto-creation, and directory setup
details: At the start of `load_config()`, attempt to resolve `$HOME` using `Path.home()` wrapped in a try/except `RuntimeError`.
If `$HOME` is unresolvable, emit a DEBUG-level warning and skip global config loading entirely (no exception raised).
If `$HOME` is resolvable, check for `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`.
If it does not exist: create `$HOME/.agent-fox/` with `os.makedirs(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)` — wrap in try/except `OSError` and raise `ConfigError` on failure.
Write default config via `generate_default_config()` to the new path.
If it exists: check for symlink via `os.path.islink()` on the final file path only; raise `ConfigError` mentioning CWE-59 if symlink detected.
Parse the global config using `tomllib.loads()` inside a try/except `tomllib.TOMLDecodeError`; raise `ConfigError` on parse failure identifying the file and error.

subtasks.title: Implement local config loading, symlink rejection, malformed TOML handling, and merge
details: After global config is loaded (or defaulted), check for `.agent-fox/config.toml` relative to `Path.cwd()`.
If the local config path exists: apply symlink check on the final file path only; raise `ConfigError` with CWE-59 message if symlink.
Parse local config with `tomllib.loads()`; raise `ConfigError` with local file path and parse error on failure.
Call `shallow_merge(global_dict, local_dict)` to produce the merged dict.
If no local config exists, use global dict as-is.
Pass the merged dict to `AgentFoxConfig.model_validate()` (Pydantic v2); existing validation errors propagate as `ConfigError`.

subtasks.title: Implement AF_CONFIG deprecation detection and warning
details: At the very start of `load_config()` (before any file I/O), check `os.environ.get('AF_CONFIG')`.
If set, print to `sys.stderr`: 'Warning: AF_CONFIG is no longer supported and has been ignored. Move your settings to $HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml (global) or .agent-fox/config.toml (local).'
Do NOT use the AF_CONFIG value for any path resolution.
Proceed with the normal global+local loading scheme.

subtasks.title: Implement debug-level logging for all config loading events
details: Use Python's `logging` module with `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` in the config module.
After successfully loading global config: `logger.debug('Loaded global config from %s', global_config_path)`.
After merging local config: `logger.debug('Merging local config from %s (sections overridden: %s)', local_path, overridden_sections)`.
When no local config found: `logger.debug('No local config found at .agent-fox/config.toml, using global config only')`.
When HOME unresolvable: `logger.debug('$HOME could not be resolved; global config loading skipped')`.
Track overridden sections during the merge step by recording which keys in local_dict are dicts (TOML sections).

subtasks.title: Update agentspec load_config to accept AgentFoxConfig instead of reading settings.yaml directly
details: Modify `agentspec`'s `load_config()` (or equivalent settings loader) to accept an `AgentFoxConfig` instance (or `SpecToolConfig`) as a parameter.
When called with a config object, read `model`, `auth_method`, `vertex_project`, `vertex_region` from `config.spec_tool` instead of opening `~/.af/settings.yaml`.
Maintain backward compatibility for internal callers by making the parameter optional with a default of `None` (triggering the migration fallback path).
Remove the direct `~/.af/settings.yaml` YAML-reading code path from the primary resolution branch.

subtasks.title: Implement AF_SPEC_MODEL env var precedence and migration fallback from ~/.af/settings.yaml
details: Implement `agentspec.resolve_model(config: AgentFoxConfig) -> str` with the following precedence chain:
1. Return `os.environ['AF_SPEC_MODEL']` if set (non-empty).
2. If `config.spec_tool` has been explicitly configured (i.e. `[spec_tool]` section was present in merged config), return `config.spec_tool.model`.

3. If `~/.af/settings.yaml` exists, read it with PyYAML, extract `model`, emit deprecation warning to `sys.stderr` mentioning migration to `[spec_tool]` in `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`, and return that model value.
4. Return hardcoded default `'claude-sonnet-4-6'`.
Detect whether `[spec_tool]` was explicitly set vs. defaulted by tracking whether the section key was present in the raw merged dict before Pydantic validation.

subtasks.title: Emit deprecation warning for settings.yaml migration fallback
details: When the migration fallback is triggered (step 3 in resolve_model), print to `sys.stderr`: 'Deprecation warning: ~/.af/settings.yaml is no longer the preferred config location. Migrate your [spec_tool] settings to $HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml.'
Ensure the warning is printed exactly once per resolve_model call.
Do not emit the warning when the hardcoded default is used (step 4).
